recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎被單一形態的小到中型母細胞取代，核質比極高、染色質細緻、胞質稀少，正常造血細胞很少，符合復發的淋巴母細胞白血病（T-ALL）。
features: Hypercellular aspirate replaced by monotonous small-to-medium blasts
Very high N:C ratio with scant basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine to slightly condensed chromatin; nucleoli indistinct
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Marked reduction of maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and largely replaced by a monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm, and round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and indistinct nucleoli. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; in a patient with prior T-lymphoblastic leukemia this represents relapse, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (cCD3, TdT, CD7, CD1a) and MRD comparison with the original phenotype.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and require flow cytometry showing CD19, CD79a and CD22 instead of cytoplasmic CD3.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts may look similar but express CD13/CD33/CD117 without cCD3; MPO cytochemistry may be negative, so flow is required.
Hematogones show a spectrum of maturation by flow cytometry with no aberrant phenotype, whereas relapsed blasts are phenotypically aberrant.
